newsitem.title: USA: NGC Q3 an indication of what's expected.
newsitem.headline: NGC Q3 an indication of what's expected.

text.p: NGC Corp Wednesday reported its second best quarter ever, saying it was an indication of what is expected in the future.
It said third quarter profits before a $2.5 million charge were $24.0 million, or $0.18 per share, a 64 percent increase over last year's $14.6 million, or $0.13 per share.
Chief executive Chuck Watson told a teleconference the results were second only to those in the first quarter, which were helped by cold weather.
Citing the August 31 merger with parts of Chevron Corp, he said the third quarter was "a good indication of what we would expect for the future."

Stating "we're pleased with the overall improved operating performance," in the latest quarter, NGC said "The company achieved higher operating margins as a result of the recent favorable prices for natural gas liquids and crude oil, which substantially improved earnings from our liquids division.
"The (natural) gas marketing segment improved as well as a result of higher gas volumes."
